运行前先预测关键输出，再对照断言和下方代码说明。核对通过后，尝试只改变一个输入或配置，解释输出为什么变化。

运行前的观察目标

标准化训练数据每维均值接近 0、标准差接近 1；反变换能恢复原始值；人工注入 Inf 后检查函数明确报告异常。

python 07_numerical_demo.py环境配置

拟合统计量、反变换并检查非有限值

07_numerical_demo.py
import torch torch.manual_seed(5)# STEP 1: 三个输出使用不同物理尺度train = torch.randn(64, 3) * torch.tensor([0.1, 10., 100.])train += torch.tensor([0.5, 0., 1000.])mean = train.mean(dim=0)scale = train.std(dim=0, unbiased=False).clamp_min(1e-6)z = (train - mean) / scaleassert torch.allclose(z.mean(dim=0), torch.zeros(3), atol=2e-6)assert torch.allclose(z.std(dim=0, unbiased=False), torch.ones(3), atol=1e-6)restored = z * scale + meanassert torch.allclose(restored, train, atol=1e-5)print("mean:", mean.tolist(), "scale:", scale.tolist()) # STEP 2: 验证集只使用训练统计量，不重新 fitvalidation = train[:4] + torch.tensor([0.2, 0., 0.])validation_z = (validation - mean) / scaleassert validation_z.shape == validation.shaperaw_error = torch.tensor([0.01, 1., 10.])normalized_mse = (raw_error / scale).square().mean()weighted_raw_mse = (raw_error.square() / scale.square()).mean()assert torch.allclose(normalized_mse, weighted_raw_mse) # STEP 3: 常数维度与非有限值需要明确处理constant = torch.ones(8, 1)constant_scale = constant.std(0, unbiased=False).clamp_min(1e-6)assert torch.isfinite((constant - constant.mean(0)) / constant_scale).all()def require_finite(name, tensor):    if not torch.isfinite(tensor).all():        raise ValueError(name + " 首次出现非有限值") require_finite("normalized training data", z)try:    require_finite("bad example", torch.tensor([1., float("inf")]))except ValueError as error:    print(error)
